title: lupulus
intro: Lupulus, commonly known as hops, is a perennial climbing plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and North America. Hops are valued for their medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, anxiety, and insomnia, as well as promoting a restful sleep. The therapeutic actions of hops include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to their use in traditional medicine for treating insomnia, restlessness, and other sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of hops include flavonoids, tannins, and essential oils, such as lupulin, which are responsible for their therapeutic properties.
